tagVocabulary.label: Combat armour
tagVocabulary.rule: body armour: sharp armour of 40% or more as made, or a fifth longer in a fight

tagVocabulary.label: Helmet
tagVocabulary.rule: on the head, with armour that matters (sharp 40% or more, or a tenth longer in a fight)

tagVocabulary.label: Headgear
tagVocabulary.rule: on the head, for warmth, shade, looks or work

tagVocabulary.label: Off-hand shield
tagVocabulary.rule: carried in the off hand (Vanilla Expanded's shields)

tagVocabulary.label: Utility
tagVocabulary.rule: a belt, pack or accessory

tagVocabulary.label: Everyday wear
tagVocabulary.rule: clothing for every day: no real armour, no strong insulation one way

tagVocabulary.label: Cold-weather
tagVocabulary.rule: its cold insulation in plain stuff is 14 °C or more and a third above its heat insulation

tagVocabulary.label: Hot-weather
tagVocabulary.rule: its heat insulation in plain stuff is 14 °C or more and a third above its cold insulation

tagVocabulary.label: Hazard gear
tagVocabulary.rule: a body piece whose toxic and vacuum worth is 5% or more and above its fight worth

tagVocabulary.label: Ceremonial
tagVocabulary.rule: worn for a title, a faith or its looks more than for a fight

tagVocabulary.label: Psycaster's
tagVocabulary.rule: its psychic or magic worth outweighs its fight

tagVocabulary.label: Royal
tagVocabulary.rule: meets a royal title's apparel rule

tagVocabulary.label: Faith's apparel
tagVocabulary.rule: a faith's role or meme asks for it

tagVocabulary.label: Work clothes
tagVocabulary.rule: makes its wearer's work 5% more or better

tagVocabulary.label: Trader's
tagVocabulary.rule: makes its wearer's talks and trade 5% better or more

tagVocabulary.label: Medic's
tagVocabulary.rule: better tending or surgery

tagVocabulary.label: Hunter's
tagVocabulary.rule: hunting stealth 20% or more, or camouflage

tagVocabulary.label: Melee fighter's
tagVocabulary.rule: rated for a melee fighter (it blocks shooting or is an off-hand shield)

tagVocabulary.label: Spacefarer's
tagVocabulary.rule: vacuum resistance of 30% or more, or an oxygen supply

tagVocabulary.label: For slaves
tagVocabulary.rule: slave apparel, or raises a slave's suppression

tagVocabulary.label: Shooter's
tagVocabulary.rule: better shooting accuracy, quicker aim or a shorter cooldown between shots

tagVocabulary.label: Builder's
tagVocabulary.rule: better construction, smoothing or repairs

tagVocabulary.label: Researcher's
tagVocabulary.rule: faster research or entity study

tagVocabulary.label: Cook's
tagVocabulary.rule: faster cooking or butchering, less food poisoning

tagVocabulary.label: Grower's
tagVocabulary.rule: faster plant work or a bigger harvest

tagVocabulary.label: Handler's
tagVocabulary.rule: faster or bigger animal gathering

tagVocabulary.label: Miner's
tagVocabulary.rule: faster mining

tagVocabulary.label: Top
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the torso, not the legs

tagVocabulary.label: Legwear
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the legs, not the torso

tagVocabulary.label: Full outfit
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the torso and the legs

tagVocabulary.label: Coat
tagVocabulary.rule: an outer layer over the torso

tagVocabulary.label: Footwear
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the feet

tagVocabulary.label: Handwear
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the hands

tagVocabulary.label: Cloak
tagVocabulary.rule: an outer layer over the neck and shoulders only

tagVocabulary.label: Hat
tagVocabulary.rule: worn on the upper head

tagVocabulary.label: Mask or hood
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the face, the mouth or the whole head

tagVocabulary.label: Eyewear
tagVocabulary.rule: worn over the eyes

tagVocabulary.label: Worn for looks
tagVocabulary.rule: it does little else: worth under 2% of a colonist in every area

tagVocabulary.label: Stops bullets
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 7 or more against guns

tagVocabulary.label: Turns blades
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 7 or more against blades, fists and animals

tagVocabulary.label: Holds off mechs
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 7 or more against mechanoids

tagVocabulary.label: Fireproof
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 7 or more against fire

tagVocabulary.label: Warm
tagVocabulary.rule: cold insulation of 20 °C or more on a coat or armour, 10 °C next to the skin, 6 °C on the head

tagVocabulary.label: Cool
tagVocabulary.rule: heat insulation of 15 °C or more on a coat or armour, 10 °C next to the skin, 6 °C on the head

tagVocabulary.label: Light
tagVocabulary.rule: armour of 5 kg or less that doesn't slow its wearer

tagVocabulary.label: Full cover
tagVocabulary.rule: armour over 80% or more of where shots land

tagVocabulary.label: Quick feet
tagVocabulary.rule: speeds its wearer up

tagVocabulary.label: Steadier aim
tagVocabulary.rule: better shooting accuracy or quicker aim

tagVocabulary.label: Melee edge
tagVocabulary.rule: better melee hit, damage or dodge

tagVocabulary.label: Shrugs off pain
tagVocabulary.rule: pain shock threshold up by 10% or more

tagVocabulary.label: Steady nerves
tagVocabulary.rule: a lower mental break threshold

tagVocabulary.label: Hard-wearing
tagVocabulary.rule: armour with 300 hit points or more

tagVocabulary.label: Carries more
tagVocabulary.rule: raises what its wearer can carry

tagVocabulary.label: Heals faster
tagVocabulary.rule: faster immunity or wound healing

tagVocabulary.label: Good impression
tagVocabulary.rule: raises social impact or negotiation

tagVocabulary.label: Slows you
tagVocabulary.rule: slows its wearer

tagVocabulary.label: Blocks shooting
tagVocabulary.rule: its shield stops its wearer's own shots

tagVocabulary.label: Blinds
tagVocabulary.rule: takes its wearer's sight

tagVocabulary.label: Thin cover
tagVocabulary.rule: armour over less than half of where shots land

tagVocabulary.label: Weak to blunt
tagVocabulary.rule: armour whose blunt rating is under a third of its sharp: fists, clubs and paws get through

tagVocabulary.label: Mechs pierce it
tagVocabulary.rule: armour that rates 2 or more lower against mechanoids than against guns

tagVocabulary.label: No warmth
tagVocabulary.rule: body armour with under 10 °C of cold insulation: useless in a blizzard

tagVocabulary.label: Worse aim
tagVocabulary.rule: lower shooting accuracy or slower aim

tagVocabulary.label: Clumsy
tagVocabulary.rule: lower melee hit or dodge

tagVocabulary.label: Slows work
tagVocabulary.rule: lower work speed

tagVocabulary.label: Bars work
tagVocabulary.rule: its wearer can't do some work, or learns nothing

tagVocabulary.label: Off-putting
tagVocabulary.rule: lowers social impact or negotiation

tagVocabulary.label: Blocks psycasts
tagVocabulary.rule: lowers psychic sensitivity: bad for a psycaster

tagVocabulary.label: Flammable
tagVocabulary.rule: burns readily: flammability of 100% or more and heat armour under 20%

tagVocabulary.label: Little warmth
tagVocabulary.rule: clothing, a helmet or other headgear with under 4 °C of insulation either way (5 °C on the head)

tagVocabulary.label: Won't stop a bullet
tagVocabulary.rule: clothing over a fifth or more of where shots land that rates 2.5 or less against guns

tagVocabulary.label: Wears fast
tagVocabulary.rule: under 60 days of wear to half its hit points, when the tattered mood starts

tagVocabulary.label: Tattered mood
tagVocabulary.rule: body armour over 30% or more of where shots land, under 200 hit points: a quarter of each hit's damage wears it, so a few fights tatter it

tagVocabulary.label: Runs out
tagVocabulary.rule: gone when its charges are used

tagVocabulary.label: Angers factions
tagVocabulary.rule: using it on someone costs goodwill with their faction

tagVocabulary.label: Hurts its wearer
tagVocabulary.rule: pain while worn

tagVocabulary.label: Wrong-gender mood
tagVocabulary.rule: made for one gender: the other is unhappy wearing it

tagVocabulary.label: Counts as naked
tagVocabulary.rule: covers the torso or legs but doesn't count as clothing

tagVocabulary.label: Explodes on death
tagVocabulary.rule: blows up when its wearer dies

tagVocabulary.label: Calls enemies
tagVocabulary.rule: brings hostile mechanoids down where it is aimed

tagVocabulary.label: Shield
tagVocabulary.rule: an energy shield that takes shots and blasts

tagVocabulary.label: Shields allies
tagVocabulary.rule: a shield field or low-shield that covers those beside its wearer

tagVocabulary.label: Jump
tagVocabulary.rule: jumps over walls and enemies

tagVocabulary.label: Smoke
tagVocabulary.rule: pops a smoke cloud that spoils shots

tagVocabulary.label: Low shield
tagVocabulary.rule: deploys a low shield that stops shots from outside for 30 seconds

tagVocabulary.label: Firefoam
tagVocabulary.rule: puts out fires around its wearer

tagVocabulary.label: Grants: (ability)
tagVocabulary.rule: throws or launches something, named

tagVocabulary.label: Psychic lance
tagVocabulary.rule: shocks or maddens one enemy from afar

tagVocabulary.label: Orbital strike
tagVocabulary.rule: calls a strike or a tornado from orbit

tagVocabulary.label: Summons help
tagVocabulary.rule: deploys a turret, a drone or the risen dead

tagVocabulary.label: Psychic
tagVocabulary.rule: raises psychic sensitivity, psychic heat or focus

tagVocabulary.label: Psychic shield
tagVocabulary.rule: lowers psychic sensitivity: shelters from drones and lances

tagVocabulary.label: Vacuum-proof
tagVocabulary.rule: vacuum resistance of 60% or more, or an oxygen supply

tagVocabulary.label: Toxin-proof
tagVocabulary.rule: toxic resistance of 50% or more, or immune to tox gas

tagVocabulary.label: Mech bandwidth
tagVocabulary.rule: adds a mechanitor's bandwidth or control groups

tagVocabulary.label: Enchanted
tagVocabulary.rule: an enchantment of A RimWorld of Magic

tagVocabulary.label: Camouflage
tagVocabulary.rule: hides its wearer while still

tagVocabulary.label: Second life
tagVocabulary.rule: brings its wearer back from death once

tagVocabulary.label: Stops bleeding
tagVocabulary.rule: its wearer bleeds less or not at all

tagVocabulary.label: Wards the body
tagVocabulary.rule: adds armour to its wearer's whole body

tagVocabulary.label: Extra gun
tagVocabulary.rule: a gun of its own that fires beside its wearer

tagVocabulary.label: Its own effect
tagVocabulary.rule: part of what it does is its mod's own code: named, not counted

tagVocabulary.label: Needs a title
tagVocabulary.rule: royal apparel: worth most to someone whose title asks for it

tagVocabulary.label: Needs a psylink
tagVocabulary.rule: its psychic gains need a psycaster

tagVocabulary.label: Mechanitor only
tagVocabulary.rule: its bandwidth needs a mechanitor

tagVocabulary.label: Needs a mage
tagVocabulary.rule: its enchantment needs a mage or a might user

tagVocabulary.label: Women only
tagVocabulary.rule: only one gender can wear it (or is meant to)

tagVocabulary.label: Children only
tagVocabulary.rule: made for children

tagVocabulary.label: Light weapon only
tagVocabulary.rule: works only with a weapon under 1.65 kg that Dual Wield allows in the off hand

tagVocabulary.label: Melee fighters only
tagVocabulary.rule: its shield stops its wearer's shots

tagVocabulary.label: Advanced research
tagVocabulary.rule: made only after spacer or ultra research

tagVocabulary.label: Hard to find
tagVocabulary.rule: no recipe in the player's game makes it and no faction's people wear it

tagVocabulary.label: Biocodable
tagVocabulary.rule: can be biocoded to one colonist

tagVocabulary.label: Stuff matters
tagVocabulary.rule: its rating moves by 1.5 or more between the common stuffs it can be made of

tagVocabulary.label: Needs (fuel)
tagVocabulary.rule: its charges are refilled with something the colony must make or buy, named

tagVocabulary.label: Belt slot
tagVocabulary.rule: takes a utility slot (a belt, an artifact, a hip): one piece in it at a time
